From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novatek.io>

Subject: Re: Draft: Novatek deployment story — final fact-check & quote sign-off

Hi Markus — thanks for sending this over. Carlos and I reviewed the draft and left tracked changes (attached). High level: we love the narrative, but we need a few adjustments before we can approve publish.

Key redlines:
- Cost savings: please change "37% average inference cost reduction" to "~35% average inference cost reduction" — our finance team prefers not to state a precision we can't substantiate publicly.
- Throughput: change "2.1x throughput increase" to "~2x throughput increase (typical workloads)".
- SLA language: remove the sentence that reads "Redwood’s setup delivered a 99.99% SLA" — replace with "Redwood and Novatek targeted a 99.9% availability objective during the rollout."
- Data residency: please add a short sentence clarifying that all customer data in the pilot remained in Novatek-managed VPCs in us-west-2.

Quote update: our VP of Engineering wants this exact phrasing instead of the draft: "Redwood’s unified runtime let us cut inference costs while keeping latency predictable — it’s been key to moving from experimentation to production."

We attached Novatek_Case_Draft_v2_elena_comments.docx with inline edits. We can sign the final PDF once the edits are reflected; legal will only approve the logo if we exchange the one-page logo usage form via DocuSign.

Attachments: Novatek_Case_Draft_v2_elena_comments.docx (docx, 23 KB)

Best,
Elena Morales
Director, Cloud Infrastructure | Novatek
elena.morales@novatek.io
